figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of RAG-Match. For each query, a RAG system retrieves top-k evidence documents and synthesizes a document for Phase I pretraining. In Phase II, GPT-5.2 generates hierarchical reasoning supervision through KIG and HMDA. In Phase III, preference pairs generated by the Phase II model are used for discrepancy-guided preference optimization.
Table 2: Main results on the search relevance benchmark. All baseline models are fine-tuned on the same labeled training data using label-only supervised fine-tuning. The best results are in bold.
